educational_notice.en: Quiz Master Rwanda provides educational information to support learning. Road safety lessons are general guidance and do not replace current Rwandan laws, official instructions, professional training or advice from relevant authorities. Always check official sources for current requirements.
educational_notice.rw: Quiz Master Rwanda itanga amakuru agamije uburezi no gufasha abantu kwiga. Amasomo y'umutekano wo mu muhanda ni inyigisho rusange; ntasimbura amategeko y'u Rwanda agezweho, amabwiriza y'inzego zibifitiye ububasha, amahugurwa y'umwuga cyangwa inama z'ababishinzwe. Buri gihe genzura amakuru atangwa n'inzego zemewe.

title.rw: Iby'ibanze ku mutekano wo mu muhanda

description.en: Understand why road safety is a shared responsibility and how careful decisions help protect everyone using the road.
description.rw: Sobanukirwa impamvu umutekano wo mu muhanda ari inshingano ya buri wese n'uko gufata ibyemezo byitonze birinda abakoresha umuhanda bose.

definition.en: Road safety refers to the knowledge, behaviour, rules and protective measures that help prevent crashes and reduce the risk of injury or death on roads.
definition.rw: Umutekano wo mu muhanda ni ubumenyi, imyitwarire, amategeko n'ingamba zo kwirinda bifasha gukumira impanuka no kugabanya ibyago byo gukomereka cyangwa gupfa mu muhanda.

en: Roads are shared spaces used by pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists, drivers and passengers. Each group has different needs, but everyone has a role in preventing crashes. A safe road environment depends on responsible behaviour, suitable infrastructure, visible signs and respect for traffic rules.

Many road crashes are linked to preventable risks such as excessive speed, distraction, unsafe overtaking, impaired driving and failure to use protective equipment. Paying attention, planning journeys and making calm decisions can reduce these risks.

Road safety is not only the responsibility of drivers. Pedestrians should use suitable crossing points where available, cyclists should make themselves visible, passengers should use available restraints and communities should support safer roads for everyone.

A responsible road user observes the environment, anticipates possible hazards and avoids actions that put others at unnecessary risk. When conditions are difficult, such as poor visibility or wet roads, extra caution is important.
rw: Umuhanda ukoreshwa n'abanyamaguru, abanyamagare, abatwara moto, abashoferi n'abagenzi. Buri tsinda rifite ibyo rikeneye byihariye, ariko buri wese afite uruhare mu gukumira impanuka. Umuhanda utekanye ushingira ku myitwarire myiza, ibikorwa remezo bikwiye, ibyapa bigaragara no kubahiriza amategeko y'umuhanda.

Impanuka nyinshi zo mu muhanda zifitanye isano n'ibyago bishobora gukumirwa, nko kugendera ku muvuduko ukabije, kurangara, kurenga nabi, gutwara ikinyabiziga umuntu atameze neza cyangwa kutambara ibikoresho birinda. Kwitwararika, gutegura urugendo no gufata ibyemezo utuje bishobora kugabanya ibyo byago.

Umutekano wo mu muhanda si inshingano z'abashoferi gusa. Abanyamaguru bagomba gukoresha ahagenewe kwambukira igihe ahari, abanyamagare bakagaragara neza, abagenzi bagakoresha imikandara ibarinda igihe ihari, naho abaturage bagashyigikira umuhanda utekanye kuri bose.

Umukoresha umuhanda witwararika areba ibimukikije, agatekereza ku bishobora guteza ibyago kandi akirinda ibikorwa bishyira abandi mu kaga bidakenewe. Iyo ibihe bitoroshye, urugero nk'igihe hatagaragara neza cyangwa umuhanda unyerera, aba agomba kurushaho kwitonda.

en: Road safety is a shared responsibility.
Pay attention to other road users and the surrounding environment.
Avoid distraction and risky decisions.
Follow current traffic signs, rules and official instructions.
Choose behaviour that protects vulnerable road users.
rw: Umutekano wo mu muhanda ni inshingano ya buri wese.
Jya witondera abandi bakoresha umuhanda n'ibikikije.
Irinde kurangara no gufata ibyemezo bishobora guteza ibyago.
Kurikiza ibyapa, amategeko n'amabwiriza y'umuhanda agezweho.
Hitamo imyitwarire irinda abakoresha umuhanda bashobora guhura n'ibyago byoroshye.

conclusion.en: Safer roads are created when every road user acts responsibly. Small careful decisions can help protect lives and make journeys safer.
conclusion.rw: Imihanda irushaho kugira umutekano iyo buri uyikoresha yitwaye neza. Ibyemezo bito byo kwitwararika bishobora gufasha kurinda ubuzima no gutuma ingendo ziba nziza.

quiz_connection.en: Think about the different people who use a road. Which actions can each person take to reduce danger?
quiz_connection.rw: Tekereza ku bantu batandukanye bakoresha umuhanda. Ni ibihe bikorwa buri wese yakora kugira ngo agabanye ibyago?

title.en: Pedestrian Safety and Safe Road Crossing

description.en: Learn how pedestrians can make safer choices before and while crossing roads.
description.rw: Menya uko abanyamaguru bafata ingamba zo kwambuka umuhanda mu buryo butekanye.

definition.en: Pedestrian safety means taking precautions to reduce the risk of being involved in a road crash while walking or crossing a road.
definition.rw: Umutekano w'umunyamaguru ni ingamba zifatwa kugira ngo agabanye ibyago byo guhura n'impanuka igihe agenda n'amaguru cyangwa yambuka umuhanda.

en: Pedestrians are among the road users who can be seriously affected in a crash because they have little physical protection. Safe walking requires awareness, patience and attention to vehicles, bicycles, motorcycles and road conditions.

Where a pedestrian crossing, footbridge or other designated crossing facility is provided, pedestrians should use it and follow the signals or instructions. Before crossing, stop in a safe place, observe traffic in all relevant directions and make sure there is enough time and space to cross safely.

Do not assume that a driver has seen you or will stop. Avoid stepping suddenly into the road from between parked vehicles or from behind an obstruction. Make yourself visible, especially in low light, rain or places where visibility is limited.

Mobile phones, headphones and other distractions can reduce awareness of approaching traffic. Give the road your full attention when crossing. Children should be taught safe crossing habits and supervised appropriately according to their age and surroundings.
rw: Abanyamaguru ni bamwe mu bakoresha umuhanda bashobora kugira ingaruka zikomeye mu mpanuka kuko baba badafite ibikoresho byinshi bibarinda. Kugenda mu mutekano bisaba kuba maso, kwihangana no kwita ku binyabiziga, amagare, moto n'imiterere y'umuhanda.

Iyo hari ahagenewe abanyamaguru kwambukira, ikiraro cy'abanyamaguru cyangwa ahandi hateganyijwe kwambukira, abanyamaguru bagomba kuhakoresha no gukurikiza amatara cyangwa amabwiriza ahari. Mbere yo kwambuka, hagarara ahatekanye, urebe ibinyabiziga mu byerekezo bireba aho uri kandi wemeze ko ufite umwanya uhagije wo kwambuka neza.

Ntukibwire ko umushoferi yakubonye cyangwa ko azahagarara. Irinde kwihutira kwinjira mu muhanda uvuye hagati y'imodoka ziparitse cyangwa inyuma y'ikintu kikubuza kubona. Jya ugaragara neza, cyane cyane iyo bwije, imvura igwa cyangwa ahantu hatagaragara neza.

Telefoni, utwuma two kumva umuziki n'ibindi bishobora kurangaza bigabanya ubushobozi bwo kubona ibinyabiziga byegera. Igihe wambuka, jya wita ku muhanda gusa. Abana bagomba kwigishwa uko bambuka neza kandi bakagenzurwa hakurikijwe imyaka yabo n'aho bari.

en: Use designated pedestrian crossings when available.
Observe traffic and signals before crossing.
Never assume that approaching drivers have seen you.
Avoid using a phone or other distracting devices while crossing.
Be visible in poor lighting and weather conditions.
rw: Koresha ahagenewe abanyamaguru kwambukira igihe ahari.
Reba ibinyabiziga n'amatara y'umuhanda mbere yo kwambuka.
Ntukibwire ko abashoferi bakwegereye bakubonye.
Irinde gukoresha telefoni cyangwa ibindi bikurangaza igihe wambuka.
Jya ugaragara neza iyo urumuri ruke cyangwa ikirere kimeze nabi.

conclusion.en: A safe pedestrian is alert, patient and visible. Taking a moment to observe traffic before crossing can prevent serious harm.
conclusion.rw: Umunyamaguru utekanye aba ari maso, yihangana kandi agaragara neza. Gufata akanya ukareba ibinyabiziga mbere yo kwambuka bishobora gukumira impanuka zikomeye.

quiz_connection.en: Why is it unsafe to assume that a vehicle will stop just because you are waiting to cross?
quiz_connection.rw: Kuki atari byiza kwibwira ko ikinyabiziga kizahagarara kubera ko utegereje kwambuka?

description.en: Discover how protective equipment helps reduce the severity of injuries during road crashes.
description.rw: Menya uko ibikoresho birinda bifasha kugabanya ubukana bw'ibikomere mu mpanuka zo mu muhanda.

definition.en: Protective equipment includes safety devices such as seat belts and properly approved motorcycle helmets that help reduce the risk or severity of injury.
definition.rw: Ibikoresho birinda birimo nk'imikandara y'umutekano n'ingofero za moto zemewe kandi zikoreshwa neza, bigafasha kugabanya ibyago cyangwa ubukana bw'ibikomere.

en: A seat belt helps keep a vehicle occupant in the correct seating position during sudden braking or a crash. It can reduce the risk of being thrown from the vehicle or striking parts of its interior. Drivers and passengers should use seat belts correctly whenever they are provided.

A motorcycle helmet is designed to help protect the head during an impact. A suitable helmet should meet applicable safety standards, fit properly and be fastened as instructed by its manufacturer. A helmet that is damaged or poorly fitted may not provide the intended protection.

Protective equipment does not make dangerous driving safe. Speed control, attention, safe following distance and respect for traffic rules remain essential. Seat belts and helmets work alongside responsible behaviour; they do not replace it.

Passengers also have a role. Before a journey, passengers should use available safety restraints and follow the driver's safety instructions. Motorcycle passengers should use suitable protective helmets where required.
rw: Umukandara w'umutekano ufasha kugumana umugenzi cyangwa umushoferi mu mwanya ukwiriye igihe ikinyabiziga gihagaze gitunguranye cyangwa habaye impanuka. Ushobora kugabanya ibyago byo kujugunywa hanze cyangwa kugonga ibice by'imbere mu kinyabiziga. Abashoferi n'abagenzi bagomba gukoresha neza imikandara igihe ihari.

Ingofero ya moto ikorwa kugira ngo ifashe kurinda umutwe igihe habayeho kugongana. Ingofero ikwiye igomba kuba yujuje ibisabwa n'amahame y'umutekano, ikaba ijyanye n'umutwe kandi igafungwa hakurikijwe amabwiriza y'uyikoze. Ingofero yangiritse cyangwa itagukwira neza ishobora kutarinda uko bikwiye.

Ibikoresho birinda ntibituma gutwara nabi cyangwa mu kaga biba byiza. Kugenzura umuvuduko, kwitwararika, gusiga intera ihagije no kubahiriza amategeko y'umuhanda biracyakenewe. Imikandara n'ingofero bifatanya n'imyitwarire myiza; ntibisimbura iyo myitwarire.

Abagenzi na bo bafite uruhare. Mbere y'urugendo, bagomba gukoresha ibikoresho bibarinda igihe bihari no gukurikiza amabwiriza y'umutekano. Abagenzi ba moto bagomba gukoresha ingofero zibereye igihe bisabwa.

en: Use a seat belt correctly whenever one is provided.
Use a suitable, properly fitted and fastened motorcycle helmet.
Replace or seek advice about damaged protective equipment.
Protective equipment reduces risk but does not prevent every injury.
Safe behaviour is still essential.
rw: Koresha neza umukandara w'umutekano igihe uhari.
Koresha ingofero ya moto ikwiye, ikwiriye umutwe kandi ifunze neza.
Ibikoresho birinda byangiritse bigomba gusimbuzwa cyangwa kugenzurwa n'ababishinzwe.
Ibikoresho birinda bigabanya ibyago ariko ntibibuza ibikomere byose.
Imyitwarire myiza mu muhanda iracyakenewe.

conclusion.en: Seat belts and helmets are important protective measures. Use them properly and combine them with careful, lawful road behaviour.
conclusion.rw: Imikandara n'ingofero ni ingamba zikomeye zo kwirinda. Bikoreshwe neza kandi bihuzwe no kwitwara neza no kubahiriza amategeko y'umuhanda.

quiz_connection.en: Explain why wearing a helmet does not give a motorcycle rider permission to take unnecessary risks.
quiz_connection.rw: Sobanura impamvu kwambara ingofero bitaha uburenganzira utwara moto bwo kwishyira mu kaga bidakenewe.

title.en: Distraction, Speed and Safe Driving Decisions
title.rw: Kurangara, umuvuduko n'ibyemezo byo gutwara neza

description.en: Learn why attention and appropriate speed are essential parts of responsible driving.
description.rw: Menya impamvu kwitwararika no kugendera ku muvuduko ukwiye ari ingenzi mu gutwara ikinyabiziga neza.

definition.en: Driver distraction occurs when attention is taken away from driving. Speed-related risk increases when a vehicle travels too fast for the legal limit, traffic, visibility or road conditions.
definition.rw: Kurangara k'umushoferi bibaho iyo ibitekerezo bye bivuye ku gutwara ikinyabiziga. Ibyago bifitanye isano n'umuvuduko biriyongera iyo ikinyabiziga kigendera ku muvuduko urenze uwemewe cyangwa udahuye n'uko umuhanda, ibinyabiziga n'uko umuntu abona bimeze.

en: Driving requires continuous attention. A driver needs to observe the road, notice signs, monitor other road users and respond to changing conditions. Using a phone, reading messages, adjusting devices or becoming deeply distracted by passengers can reduce the attention available for driving.

Speed affects how much distance a vehicle covers before the driver can respond and how much distance may be needed to stop. At higher speeds, a driver generally has less time to identify a hazard and react. The consequences of a crash can also become more severe.

A safe speed is not simply the highest speed shown on a road sign. Drivers must obey the applicable limit and consider weather, visibility, road surface, traffic, pedestrians and the condition of the vehicle. They may need to travel more slowly when conditions are difficult.

Planning before starting a journey helps reduce distraction. Set navigation, arrange essential items and make necessary calls before driving. If something requires attention, stop in a safe and lawful place before dealing with it.
rw: Gutwara ikinyabiziga bisaba guhora witwararika. Umushoferi agomba kureba umuhanda, kubona ibyapa, gukurikirana abandi bawukoresha no kwitwara bitewe n'uko ibintu bihinduka. Gukoresha telefoni, gusoma ubutumwa, gukorakora ibikoresho cyangwa kurangazwa cyane n'abagenzi bishobora kugabanya ubushobozi bwo kwita ku gutwara.

Umuvuduko ugira ingaruka ku ntera ikinyabiziga kigenda mbere y'uko umushoferi agira icyo akora no ku ntera gishobora gukenera kugira ngo gihagarare. Iyo umuvuduko wiyongereye, umushoferi aba afite igihe gito cyo kubona icyago no kugisubiza. Ingaruka z'impanuka na zo zishobora kurushaho gukomera.

Umuvuduko utekanye si umuvuduko wo hejuru wanditse ku cyapa gusa. Abashoferi bagomba kubahiriza umuvuduko wemewe kandi bakita ku kirere, uko babona, uko umuhanda umeze, ibinyabiziga, abanyamaguru n'imiterere y'ikinyabiziga. Ibihe bigoye bishobora gusaba kugabanya umuvuduko.

Gutegura urugendo mbere yo kurutangira bifasha kugabanya kurangara. Tegura inzira, ibikoresho ukeneye n'amahamagara mbere yo gutwara. Niba hari ikintu gisaba kwitabwaho, banza uhagarare ahantu hatekanye kandi hemewe mbere yo kugikora.

en: Keep attention on driving and the road environment.
Do not read or type messages while driving.
Obey speed limits and adjust speed to conditions.
Allow enough time and space to respond to hazards.
Stop safely before handling distractions.
rw: Ita ku gutwara no ku mimerere y'umuhanda.
Ntugasome cyangwa ngo wandike ubutumwa utwaye ikinyabiziga.
Kubahiriza umuvuduko wemewe kandi uwuhuze n'uko umuhanda umeze.
Siga igihe n'intera bihagije kugira ngo ubashe kwitwara igihe habaye icyago.
Banza uhagarare ahatekanye mbere yo gukemura ikikurangaza.

conclusion.en: Attention and appropriate speed help drivers respond to hazards. Responsible driving means choosing safety over haste.
conclusion.rw: Kwitwararika no kugendera ku muvuduko ukwiye bifasha abashoferi kwitwara igihe habaye icyago. Gutwara neza bisaba gushyira umutekano imbere yihuta.

quiz_connection.en: Give two examples of distractions that can take a driver's attention away from the road.
quiz_connection.rw: Tanga ingero ebyiri z'ibishobora kurangaza umushoferi bikamuvana ku kwita ku muhanda.

title.en: Understanding Traffic Signs and Road Markings
title.rw: Gusobanukirwa ibyapa n'ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda

description.en: Explore how signs, signals and road markings communicate important information to road users.
description.rw: Menya uko ibyapa, amatara n'ibimenyetso bishushanyije mu muhanda bigeza amakuru y'ingenzi ku bawukoresha.

definition.en: Traffic signs and road markings are visual communication tools that guide, warn, regulate and inform people using roads.
definition.rw: Ibyapa n'ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda ni uburyo bwo gutanga amakuru agaragara buyobora, buburira, bugenga kandi busobanurira abakoresha umuhanda.

en: Traffic signs help road users understand what is required, what may be ahead and which actions are restricted or permitted. They are important because road users need clear information before reaching intersections, crossings, bends, work zones and other places where conditions may change.

Signs can communicate different types of information, including warnings about possible hazards, instructions that must be followed and information about destinations or services. Their shape, colour, symbols and placement help users recognise their meaning.

Road markings also provide guidance. Lines may separate traffic flows, indicate lane boundaries or show places where particular movements are restricted. Pedestrian crossings identify areas intended for people walking to cross. Drivers should pay attention to both signs and markings rather than relying on one alone.

Traffic lights and signs should be understood together with the current road rules. If a sign is damaged, unclear or temporarily covered, road users should proceed cautiously and follow instructions from authorised traffic officers where present. Learners should study official, current materials rather than memorising uncertain pictures from unofficial sources.
rw: Ibyapa bifasha abakoresha umuhanda kumenya ibisabwa, ibishobora kuba biri imbere n'ibikorwa byemewe cyangwa bibujijwe. Ni ingenzi kuko abakoresha umuhanda bakeneye amakuru asobanutse mbere yo kugera mu masangano, ahambukira abanyamaguru, mu mihanda igoramye, ahakorerwa imirimo n'ahandi hashobora guhinduka.

Ibyapa bitanga amakuru atandukanye, harimo kuburira ku byago bishobora kuba biri imbere, amabwiriza agomba gukurikizwa n'amakuru y'aho umuntu agana cyangwa serivisi zihari. Imiterere yabyo, amabara, ibishushanyo n'aho bishyirwa bifasha abantu gusobanukirwa n'icyo bivuze.

Ibimenyetso bishushanyije mu muhanda na byo birayobora. Imirongo ishobora gutandukanya ibyerekezo by'ibinyabiziga, kugaragaza imipaka y'umurongo cyangwa ahantu ibikorwa bimwe bibujijwe. Ahambukira abanyamaguru hagaragaza ahagenewe abantu bagenda n'amaguru. Abashoferi bagomba kwita ku byapa no ku bimenyetso byo hasi mu muhanda byombi.

Amatara y'umuhanda n'ibyapa bigomba kumvikana hamwe n'amategeko y'umuhanda agezweho. Iyo icyapa cyangiritse, kitumvikana cyangwa gitwikiriwe by'agateganyo, abakoresha umuhanda bagomba kwitonda no gukurikiza amabwiriza y'abashinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda igihe bahari. Abiga bagomba gukoresha inyandiko zemewe kandi zigezweho aho gufata mu mutwe amashusho atizewe yo ku mbuga zitazwi.

en: Signs warn, regulate, guide and provide information.
Pay attention to the shape, colour and symbol of a sign.
Road markings help organise traffic and identify crossing areas.
Observe signs, road markings and traffic signals together.
Use official and up-to-date learning materials.
rw: Ibyapa biraburira, biragena, birayobora kandi bitanga amakuru.
Ita ku miterere, ibara n'ikimenyetso kiri ku cyapa.
Ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda bifasha gutunganya ingendo no kugaragaza ahambukira.
Reba ibyapa, ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda n'amatara byose hamwe.
Koresha inyigisho zemewe kandi zigezweho.

conclusion.en: Understanding road signs and markings helps people make informed decisions. Always learn their meanings from current official materials.
conclusion.rw: Gusobanukirwa ibyapa n'ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda bifasha abantu gufata ibyemezo bishingiye ku makuru. Buri gihe ujye wiga ibisobanuro byabyo mu nyandiko zemewe kandi zigezweho.

quiz_connection.en: What are three purposes of traffic signs?
quiz_connection.rw: Vuga intego eshatu z'ibyapa byo mu muhanda.

title.en: The Scientific Method and Critical Thinking
title.rw: Uburyo bwa siyansi no gutekereza byimbitse

description.en: Learn how questions, observations, evidence and testing help people investigate the world.
description.rw: Menya uko ibibazo, kwitegereza, ibimenyetso no kugerageza bifasha abantu gukora ubushakashatsi ku bidukikije.

definition.en: The scientific method is a systematic approach to investigating questions using observation, testable explanations, evidence and careful evaluation.
definition.rw: Uburyo bwa siyansi ni inzira iteguye yo gukora ubushakashatsi ku bibazo hakoreshejwe kwitegereza, ibisobanuro bishobora kugeragezwa, ibimenyetso no gusuzuma neza ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi.

en: Science is a way of learning about the natural and physical world through careful observation and evidence. It does not depend only on opinions or guesses. Scientific explanations should be open to testing and revision when stronger evidence becomes available.

An investigation often begins with a question. A learner observes something, identifies what they want to understand and proposes a possible explanation called a hypothesis. The hypothesis should be clear enough to investigate.

The next step may involve collecting information or carrying out a fair test. A good investigation records observations carefully, changes only the factors being tested where possible and considers other explanations. Repeating tests can help show whether a result is consistent.

After examining the evidence, the investigator explains what the results suggest and identifies limitations. A result does not always prove an idea permanently. Other researchers may repeat the work, challenge the explanation or discover new evidence.

Critical thinking is useful beyond science. It means checking the quality of information, asking how a claim is supported and being willing to change a conclusion when reliable evidence points in another direction.
rw: Siyansi ni uburyo bwo kumenya isi n'ibiyigize hifashishijwe kwitegereza neza no gukoresha ibimenyetso. Ntishingira ku bitekerezo cyangwa gukeka gusa. Ibisobanuro bya siyansi bigomba kuba bishobora kugeragezwa kandi bigahindurwa igihe habonetse ibimenyetso bikomeye kurushaho.

Ubushakashatsi akenshi butangirana n'ikibazo. Umuntu yitegereza ikintu, akagaragaza icyo ashaka gusobanukirwa, hanyuma agatanga igitekerezo cy'igisubizo gishobora kugeragezwa, cyitwa hypothesis. Icyo gitekerezo kigomba kuba gisobanutse ku buryo gishobora gukorerwa ubushakashatsi.

Intambwe ikurikira ishobora kuba ugukusanya amakuru cyangwa gukora igerageza riboneye. Ubushakashatsi bwiza bwandika ibyo bwitegereje neza, bugahindura gusa ibintu biri kugeragezwa igihe bishoboka kandi bugatekereza ku bindi bisobanuro bishoboka. Gusubiramo igerageza bishobora gufasha kumenya niba ibisubizo bihoraho.

Nyuma yo gusuzuma ibimenyetso, ukora ubushakashatsi asobanura icyo ibisubizo byerekana kandi akagaragaza aho ubushakashatsi bugarukira. Igisubizo ntigihita gihamya igitekerezo burundu. Abandi bashakashatsi bashobora gusubiramo ubushakashatsi, kunenga ibisobanuro cyangwa kubona ibimenyetso bishya.

Gutekereza byimbitse ni ingenzi no hanze ya siyansi. Bisobanura kugenzura ubwiza bw'amakuru, kubaza ibimenyetso bishyigikira ikivugwa no kwemera guhindura umwanzuro igihe ibimenyetso byizewe byerekana ibindi.

en: Begin an investigation with a clear question.
A hypothesis is a testable possible explanation.
Collect and record evidence carefully.
Consider limitations and alternative explanations.
Be ready to revise a conclusion when reliable new evidence appears.
rw: Tangira ubushakashatsi ufite ikibazo gisobanutse.
Hypothesis ni igitekerezo cy'igisubizo gishobora kugeragezwa.
Kusanya kandi wandike ibimenyetso witonze.
Tekereza ku mbogamizi z'ubushakashatsi no ku bindi bisobanuro bishoboka.
Itegure guhindura umwanzuro igihe hagaragaye ibimenyetso bishya byizewe.

conclusion.en: Good science depends on curiosity, careful testing and honest evaluation of evidence. Critical thinking helps people make better-informed decisions.
conclusion.rw: Siyansi nziza ishingira ku kugira amatsiko yo kumenya, kugerageza witonze no gusuzuma ibimenyetso mu kuri. Gutekereza byimbitse bifasha abantu gufata ibyemezo bishingiye ku makuru meza.

quiz_connection.en: What is the difference between an observation and a hypothesis?
quiz_connection.rw: Itandukaniro riri hagati yo kwitegereza n'igitekerezo gishobora kugeragezwa ni irihe?

description.en: Understand how water moves between the land, oceans, atmosphere and living things.
description.rw: Sobanukirwa uko amazi azenguruka hagati y'ubutaka, inyanja, ikirere n'ibinyabuzima.

definition.en: The water cycle is the continuous movement of water through evaporation, condensation, precipitation, collection and other natural processes.
definition.rw: Uruziga rw'amazi ni urugendo ruhoraho amazi akora binyuze mu guhinduka umwuka, kwibumbira mu bitonyanga, kugwa kw'imvura, gukusanyiriza hamwe n'izindi nzira kamere.

en: Water is constantly moving through the environment. Heat from the Sun causes water from oceans, lakes, rivers and wet surfaces to evaporate. Plants also release water vapour into the atmosphere through a process called transpiration.

As water vapour rises and cools, it can condense into tiny droplets or ice crystals. These form clouds. When droplets or ice particles become large and heavy enough, water may fall back to Earth as rain, snow or other forms of precipitation, depending on atmospheric conditions.

Some precipitation flows over the land into streams, rivers, lakes and oceans. Some infiltrates the soil and may become groundwater. Plants can absorb water from the soil, and water can return to the atmosphere through evaporation and transpiration.

The water cycle helps distribute fresh water, supports ecosystems and influences weather and climate. Human activities such as pollution, deforestation and changes in land use can affect water quality and how water moves through an area.
Protecting water sources, reducing pollution and using water responsibly help maintain healthy ecosystems and reliable supplies of clean water.
rw: Amazi ahora azenguruka mu bidukikije. Ubushyuhe buturuka ku zuba butuma amazi yo mu nyanja, ibiyaga, imigezi no ku buso butose ahinduka umwuka. Ibimera na byo birekura umwuka w'amazi ujya mu kirere binyuze mu nzira yitwa transpiration.

Iyo umwuka w'amazi uzamutse ugakonja, ushobora kwibumbira mu bitonyanga bito cyangwa utubumbe tw'urubura. Ibyo bigakora ibicu. Iyo ibitonyanga cyangwa uduce tw'urubura bibaye binini kandi biremereye bihagije, amazi ashobora kongera kugwa ku isi ari imvura, urubura cyangwa ubundi buryo bitewe n'uko ikirere kimeze.

Amazi amwe atemba ku butaka akajya mu migezi, inzuzi, ibiyaga no mu nyanja. Andi yinjira mu butaka akazaba amazi yo munsi y'ubutaka. Ibimera bishobora gukurura amazi mu butaka, na yo akongera gusubira mu kirere binyuze mu guhinduka umwuka no mu guhumeka kw'ibimera.

Uruziga rw'amazi rufasha gukwirakwiza amazi meza, gushyigikira urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima no kugira uruhare mu miterere y'ikirere n'ibihe. Ibikorwa by'abantu nko kwanduza amazi, gutema amashyamba no guhindura imikoreshereze y'ubutaka bishobora kugira ingaruka ku bwiza bw'amazi no ku buryo agenda.
Kurinda amasoko y'amazi, kugabanya umwanda no gukoresha amazi neza bifasha kubungabunga urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima no kubona amazi meza ahagije.

en: Solar energy drives much of the water cycle.
Evaporation changes liquid water into water vapour.
Condensation helps form clouds.
Precipitation returns water to the Earth's surface.
Water conservation and pollution prevention protect water resources.
rw: Ingufu z'izuba ni zo zituma igice kinini cy'uruhererekane rw'amazi gikomeza.
Evaporation ihindura amazi y'ubutaremo umwuka w'amazi.
Condensation ifasha gukora ibicu.
Precipitation ni igihe amazi yongera kugwa ku butaka.
Kugabanya gusesagura amazi no gukumira umwanda birinda umutungo w'amazi.

conclusion.en: The water cycle continually renews the movement of water through nature. Protecting water quality is important for people, plants and animals.
conclusion.rw: Uruziga rw'amazi rutuma amazi akomeza kuzenguruka mu bidukikije. Kurinda ubwiza bw'amazi ni ingenzi ku bantu, ibimera n'inyamaswa.

quiz_connection.en: Name three important processes in the water cycle and explain what each one does.
quiz_connection.rw: Vuga inzira eshatu z'ingenzi mu ruziga rw'amazi kandi usobanure icyo buri imwe ikora.

description.en: Explore the variety of life on Earth and why healthy ecosystems matter to people and nature.
description.rw: Menya amoko atandukanye y'ibinyabuzima ku isi n'impamvu ibidukikije bizima ari ingenzi ku bantu no kuri kamere.

definition.en: Biodiversity is the variety of living organisms, including diversity within species, between species and among ecosystems.
definition.rw: Urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima ni ubwinshi n'ubwoko butandukanye bw'ibinyabuzima, harimo itandukaniro riri mu bwoko bumwe, hagati y'amoko atandukanye no hagati y'ibidukikije.

en: Biodiversity includes plants, animals, fungi and microorganisms, as well as the ecosystems in which they live. It can be considered at different levels: genetic diversity within a species, diversity of species and diversity of ecosystems such as forests, wetlands, grasslands and lakes.

Ecosystems are communities of living organisms interacting with each other and with non-living parts of their environment, such as water, air, soil and sunlight. These relationships support processes such as pollination, nutrient cycling, soil formation and the natural regulation of pests.

People depend on healthy ecosystems for food, clean water, materials, medicines, livelihoods and protection from some environmental hazards. Natural areas can also support tourism, learning, cultural values and recreation.

Biodiversity faces pressures from habitat destruction, pollution, overexploitation of natural resources, invasive species and climate change. These pressures can reduce populations and disrupt ecological relationships.

Conservation includes protecting habitats, restoring damaged areas, using natural resources responsibly and supporting community participation. Everyday choices, such as reducing waste and respecting protected areas, can contribute to environmental protection.
rw: Urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima rurimo ibimera, inyamaswa, ibihumyo n'udukoko tutagaragara n'amaso, hamwe n'ibidukikije bibamo. Rushobora kureberwa ku nzego zitandukanye: itandukaniro ry'uturemangingo mu bwoko bumwe, amoko atandukanye y'ibinyabuzima n'ibidukikije bitandukanye nk'amashyamba, ibishanga, inzuri n'ibiyaga.

Ibidukikije ni uruhurirane rw'ibinyabuzima bikorana hagati yabyo kandi bigakorana n'ibintu bitari bizima bibikikije, nk'amazi, umwuka, ubutaka n'izuba. Iyo mikoranire ifasha mu bikorwa nko gufasha ibimera kororoka, kuzenguruka kw'intungamubiri, kurema ubutaka no kugenzura udukoko twangiza mu buryo kamere.

Abantu bakeneye ibidukikije bizima kugira ngo babone ibiribwa, amazi meza, ibikoresho, imiti, imibereho n'uburinzi ku ngaruka zimwe z'ibidukikije. Ahantu nyaburanga hashobora no gufasha ubukerarugendo, kwiga, kubungabunga umuco no kuruhuka.

Urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima ruhura n'ibibazo biterwa no kwangiza aho bibera, umwanda, gukoresha umutungo kamere birenze urugero, amoko yinjizwa ahantu atari asanzwe abamo n'imihindagurikire y'ikirere. Ibyo bishobora kugabanya umubare w'ibinyabuzima no guhungabanya imikoranire yabyo.

Kubungabunga ibidukikije birimo kurinda aho ibinyabuzima biba, gusana ahangiritse, gukoresha umutungo kamere mu buryo burambye no gushyigikira uruhare rw'abaturage. Ibyo dukora buri munsi, nko kugabanya imyanda no kubaha ahantu harinzwe, bishobora gufasha kurengera ibidukikije.

en: Biodiversity includes genes, species and ecosystems.
Living things interact with one another and with their environment.
Healthy ecosystems provide important benefits to people.
Habitat loss, pollution and climate change can threaten biodiversity.
Conservation requires responsible choices and collective action.
rw: Urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima rurimo uturemangingo, amoko n'ibidukikije.
Ibinyabuzima bikorana hagati yabyo no n'ibidukikije bibikikije.
Ibidukikije bizima biha abantu inyungu nyinshi z'ingenzi.
Kwangiza aho ibinyabuzima biba, umwanda n'imihindagurikire y'ikirere bishobora kubibangamira.
Kubungabunga ibidukikije bisaba imyitwarire myiza n'ubufatanye.

conclusion.en: Biodiversity supports the natural systems on which life depends. Protecting habitats and using resources responsibly helps maintain a healthier environment.
conclusion.rw: Urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima rushyigikira imikorere ya kamere ubuzima bushingiyeho. Kurinda aho ibinyabuzima biba no gukoresha umutungo kamere neza bifasha kubungabunga ibidukikije.

quiz_connection.en: Give two examples of how healthy ecosystems benefit people.
quiz_connection.rw: Tanga ingero ebyiri z'uburyo ibidukikije bizima bigirira abantu akamaro.

description.en: Learn how geography and maps help people understand locations, landscapes and relationships between places.
description.rw: Menya uko geografiya n'amakarita bifasha abantu gusobanukirwa ahantu, imiterere y'ubutaka n'isano iri hagati y'ahantu hatandukanye.

definition.en: Geography is the study of places, environments, physical features and the relationships between people and the world around them.
definition.rw: Geografiya ni ubumenyi bwiga ahantu, ibidukikije, imiterere kamere y'isi n'isano iri hagati y'abantu n'isi ibakikije.

en: Geography helps explain where things are, why places differ and how people interact with their environments. Physical geography studies features such as mountains, rivers, climate, soils and natural vegetation. Human geography examines population, settlements, transport, economic activities and cultures.

Maps are tools for representing places and spatial information. A map may show roads, rivers, boundaries, landforms, buildings or other features. The title explains the subject, the legend explains symbols, the scale relates map distance to real distance and the orientation helps users understand direction.

Latitude and longitude are coordinate systems used to describe locations on Earth's surface. Latitude measures position north or south of the Equator, while longitude measures position east or west of the Prime Meridian.

Maps can be general or specialised. A road map supports navigation, a physical map highlights natural features and a thematic map focuses on one topic such as rainfall, population or land use. Digital maps can add interactive information, but users should still check the date and reliability of the data.
Geographic knowledge is useful for planning journeys, understanding weather patterns, managing natural resources and learning how communities are connected.
rw: Geografiya ifasha gusobanura aho ibintu biherereye, impamvu ahantu hatandukanye n'uko abantu babana n'ibidukikije. Geografiya karemano yiga ibintu nk'imisozi, inzuzi, ikirere, ubutaka n'ibimera kamere. Geografiya y'abantu yiga abaturage, aho batuye, ubwikorezi, ibikorwa by'ubukungu n'umuco.

Ikarita ni igikoresho kigaragaza ahantu n'amakuru yerekeye aho ibintu biherereye. Ikarita ishobora kugaragaza imihanda, inzuzi, imbibi, imiterere y'ubutaka, inyubako n'ibindi. Umutwe wayo usobanura icyo igaragaza, urufunguzo rusobanura ibimenyetso, igipimo kigereranya intera yo ku ikarita n'intera nyayo, naho icyerekezo kigafasha kumenya aho ibintu biherereye.

Latitude na longitude ni uburyo bwo kugaragaza aho ahantu riherereye ku buso bw'isi. Latitude igaragaza aho ahantu hari mu majyaruguru cyangwa mu majyepfo y'umurongo wa Equator, naho longitude ikerekana aho hari mu burasirazuba cyangwa mu burengerazuba bw'umurongo wa Prime Meridian.

Amakarita ashobora kuba rusange cyangwa yihariye. Ikarita y'imihanda ifasha mu kugenda, ikarita karemano igaragaza imiterere y'isi, naho ikarita y'insanganyamatsiko ikibanda ku kintu kimwe nk'imvura, abaturage cyangwa imikoreshereze y'ubutaka. Amakarita yo kuri murandasi ashobora kugira amakuru umuntu akoraho, ariko ni ngombwa kugenzura igihe amakuru yatangiwe n'ubwizerwe bwayo.
Ubumenyi bwa geografiya bufasha gutegura ingendo, gusobanukirwa imiterere y'ikirere, gucunga umutungo kamere no kumenya uko abaturage n'ahantu bahuzwa.

en: Physical geography studies natural features and processes.
Human geography studies people and their activities in places.
A map legend explains the symbols used on a map.
Latitude and longitude help identify locations.
Always consider the date and reliability of map information.
rw: Geografiya karemano yiga imiterere n'imikorere ya kamere.
Geografiya y'abantu yiga abantu n'ibikorwa byabo ahantu hatandukanye.
Urufunguzo rw'ikarita rusobanura ibimenyetso biyiriho.
Latitude na longitude bifasha kumenya aho ahantu riherereye.
Buri gihe tekereza ku gihe amakuru y'ikarita yatangiwe n'ubwizerwe bwayo.

conclusion.en: Geography and maps help people understand the world and make informed decisions about places, travel and resources.
conclusion.rw: Geografiya n'amakarita bifasha abantu gusobanukirwa isi no gufata ibyemezo bishingiye ku makuru yerekeye ahantu, ingendo n'umutungo.

quiz_connection.en: What information does a map legend provide, and why is map scale useful?
quiz_connection.rw: Urufunguzo rw'ikarita rutanga ayahe makuru, kandi kuki igipimo cy'ikarita ari ingenzi?

description.en: Build skills for checking information, recognising misleading claims and using digital media responsibly.
description.rw: Wunguke ubumenyi bwo kugenzura amakuru, kumenya ibivugwa biyobya no gukoresha ibitangazamakuru byo kuri murandasi neza.

definition.en: Media and information literacy is the ability to access, analyse, evaluate and responsibly create or share information across different media.
definition.rw: Kumenya gusuzuma amakuru n'ibitangazamakuru ni ubushobozi bwo kubona, gusesengura, kugenzura no gukora cyangwa gusangiza abandi amakuru mu buryo bufite inshingano.

en: People receive information from websites, social networks, television, radio, newspapers, messaging applications and other sources. Not every message is accurate, complete or presented fairly. Media literacy helps people think carefully about what they see and hear.

Before sharing a claim, check who created it, when it was published, what evidence supports it and whether other reliable sources report the same information. A headline alone may not represent the full meaning of an article.

Images and videos can be taken out of context, edited or shared with incorrect descriptions. Look for the original source, publication date and surrounding information. Be cautious when a post uses extreme language, promises an easy answer or pressures people to share immediately.

Protect personal information online. Think carefully before sharing private details, location information, passwords or photographs. Use strong, unique passwords where possible and review privacy settings on digital services.

Responsible digital participation includes respecting others, avoiding harassment, crediting original creators and correcting mistakes when reliable evidence shows that information shared earlier was wrong.
rw: Abantu babona amakuru ku mbuga za internet, ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, kuri televiziyo, kuri radiyo, mu binyamakuru, muri porogaramu zo koherezanya ubutumwa no mu bindi bitangazamakuru. Ubutumwa bwose si bwo buba ari ukuri, bwuzuye cyangwa bwatanzwe mu buryo butabogamye. Ubumenyi ku bitangazamakuru bufasha abantu gutekereza neza ku byo babona n'ibyo bumva.

Mbere yo gusangiza abandi amakuru, genzura uyatangaje, igihe yatangiwe, ibimenyetso biyashyigikira n'uko andi masoko yizewe abivugaho. Umutwe w'inkuru wonyine ushobora kutagaragaza igitekerezo cyose kiri mu nkuru.

Amafoto na videwo bishobora gukurwa mu miterere yabyo, guhindurwa cyangwa gusangizwa abantu biherekejwe n'ibisobanuro bitari byo. Shakisha aho byaturutse, igihe byatangiriye n'andi makuru abikikije. Witondere ubutumwa bukoresha amagambo akabije, butanga igisubizo cyoroshye kuri buri kibazo cyangwa buguhatira kubusangiza abandi ako kanya.

Rinda amakuru yawe bwite kuri internet. Tekereza neza mbere yo gusangiza abandi amakuru y'ibanga, aho uherereye, amagambo banga cyangwa amafoto. Aho bishoboka koresha amagambo banga akomeye kandi atandukanye, kandi ujye ugenzura uburyo serivisi ukoresha zirinda amakuru yawe.

Gukoresha internet ufite inshingano birimo kubaha abandi, kwirinda kubatoteza, kuvuga aho igitekerezo cyangwa igihangano cyaturutse no gukosora amakosa igihe ibimenyetso byizewe byerekanye ko amakuru wasangije mbere atari yo.

en: Check the original source and publication date.
Look for evidence and confirmation from reliable sources.
Do not trust a headline without reading the full context.
Protect passwords and personal information.
Share information responsibly and correct mistakes.
rw: Genzura isoko y'umwimerere n'igihe amakuru yatangiwe.
Shakisha ibimenyetso n'andi masoko yizewe abyemeza.
Ntukizere umutwe w'inkuru utarasomye ibisobanuro byayo byose.
Rinda amagambo banga n'amakuru yawe bwite.
Sangiza abandi amakuru ufite inshingano kandi ukosore amakosa.

conclusion.en: Being informed requires more than reading or watching. Check evidence, protect your privacy and think before sharing information.
conclusion.rw: Kugira amakuru meza bisaba ibirenze gusoma cyangwa kureba. Genzura ibimenyetso, rinda ubuzima bwite kandi ubanze utekereze mbere yo gusangiza abandi amakuru.

quiz_connection.en: List three checks you should make before sharing a surprising claim online.
quiz_connection.rw: Vuga ibintu bitatu ugomba kugenzura mbere yo gusangiza abandi amakuru atangaje kuri internet.

title.rw: Ibihe by'ikirere, imiterere y'ikirere n'imihindagurikire yabyo

description.en: Understand the difference between weather and climate and explore why the Earth's climate is changing.
description.rw: Sobanukirwa itandukaniro riri hagati y'uko ikirere kimeze ubu n'imiterere yacyo mu gihe kirekire, unamenye impamvu imihindagurikire y'ikirere ibaho.

definition.en: Weather describes short-term atmospheric conditions, while climate describes patterns and averages of weather over long periods.
definition.rw: Ibihe by'ikirere bisobanura uko ikirere kimeze mu gihe gito, naho imiterere y'ikirere ikavuga uko ibihe byagiye biba mu gihe kirekire n'impuzandengo yabyo.

en: Weather describes conditions such as temperature, rainfall, wind, humidity and cloud cover at a particular time and place. It can change over minutes, hours or days. A weather forecast estimates the conditions that may occur in the near future.

Climate describes typical weather patterns in a region over many years. It includes averages as well as the frequency of events such as droughts, heavy rainfall or heatwaves. One unusually cold day does not by itself show that the climate is becoming colder.

The Earth's climate changes naturally over time, but scientific evidence shows that the recent rapid warming is mainly caused by human activities that increase heat-trapping greenhouse gases. Burning fossil fuels, deforestation and some industrial and agricultural activities contribute to these emissions.

Climate change can affect rainfall patterns, temperatures, ecosystems, agriculture, water availability and human health. The effects differ from one region to another, and communities may face different levels of risk.

Climate action includes reducing greenhouse gas emissions, protecting forests, improving energy efficiency and preparing communities for climate impacts. Reliable scientific information helps people understand risks and choose appropriate responses.
rw: Ibihe by'ikirere bisobanura uko ubushyuhe, imvura, umuyaga, ubuhehere n'ibicu bimeze ahantu runaka no mu gihe runaka. Bishobora guhinduka mu minota, amasaha cyangwa iminsi. Iteganyagihe ritanga igereranya ry'uko ikirere gishobora kumera mu gihe kiri imbere.

Imiterere y'ikirere isobanura uko ibihe bisanzwe bigenda biba mu karere mu gihe cy'imyaka myinshi. Harimo impuzandengo n'inshuro ibintu nk'amapfa, imvura nyinshi cyangwa ubushyuhe bukabije bibaho. Umunsi umwe ukonje bidasanzwe ntuhagije ngo ugaragaze ko imiterere y'ikirere iri gukonja.

Imiterere y'ikirere cy'isi ishobora guhinduka mu buryo kamere uko igihe gihita, ariko ibimenyetso bya siyansi byerekana ko ubushyuhe bwiyongera vuba muri iki gihe ahanini buterwa n'ibikorwa by'abantu byongera imyuka ifata ubushyuhe mu kirere. Gutwika ibikomoka kuri peteroli, gutema amashyamba n'ibikorwa bimwe by'inganda n'ubuhinzi bigira uruhare mu kongera iyo myuka.

Imihindagurikire y'ikirere ishobora kugira ingaruka ku buryo imvura igwa, ubushyuhe, ibidukikije, ubuhinzi, amazi ahari n'ubuzima bw'abantu. Ingaruka ziratandukana bitewe n'akarere, kandi abaturage bashobora guhura n'ibyago bitandukanye.

Guhangana n'imihindagurikire y'ikirere birimo kugabanya imyuka ihumanya, kurinda amashyamba, gukoresha ingufu neza no gutegura abaturage guhangana n'ingaruka zayo. Amakuru yizewe ya siyansi afasha abantu kumva ibyago no guhitamo ingamba zikwiye.

en: Weather describes short-term atmospheric conditions.
Climate describes long-term patterns.
Human activities are the main cause of recent global warming.
Climate change can affect water, food systems, ecosystems and health.
Reducing emissions and preparing for impacts are both important.
rw: Ibihe by'ikirere bisobanura uko ikirere kimeze mu gihe gito.
Imiterere y'ikirere isobanura uko ibihe bigenda biba mu gihe kirekire.
Ibikorwa by'abantu ni byo ahanini bitera ubushyuhe bwiyongera vuba muri iki gihe.
Imihindagurikire y'ikirere ishobora kugira ingaruka ku mazi, ibiribwa, ibidukikije n'ubuzima.
Kugabanya imyuka ihumanya no kwitegura guhangana n'ingaruka zayo byombi ni ingenzi.

conclusion.en: Weather and climate describe different time scales. Understanding climate science helps communities prepare for change and protect people and nature.
conclusion.rw: Ibihe by'ikirere n'imiterere y'ikirere bisobanura ibihe bitandukanye. Gusobanukirwa siyansi y'imihindagurikire y'ikirere bifasha abaturage kwitegura impinduka no kurinda abantu na kamere.

quiz_connection.en: Explain the difference between weather and climate, using one example of each.
quiz_connection.rw: Sobanura itandukaniro riri hagati y'ibihe by'ikirere n'imiterere y'ikirere, utanga urugero rumwe kuri buri kimwe.
